title: Git Hub grant database operations
responsibility: Store versioned GitHub grants and coordinate refreshes and revocation with conditional updates.

inputs.name: d1GrantStore.db
inputs.description: D1-compatible database handle; queries run only when the returned store methods are called.

inputs.name: d1GrantStore.records
inputs.description: Validator used to turn stored database rows into typed records.

outputs.name: EXPIRE_GRANTS
outputs.description: SQL statement that erases expired grant tokens, increments generation and retains a revoked row; caller supplies time and executes it.

outputs.name: d1GrantStore
outputs.description: Store for reading grant state, connecting at an expected generation, leasing refresh, rotating held tokens and revoking grants. Conditional mutations return whether a row matched. Missing records read as generation zero with no grant or lease.
